title: MapleStory M May 20/21, 2026 Patch Notes Part 2
original_title: 05.20/21 Patch Notes Pt.2 (Aran and Shade Growth Support Event, M4U Boss Invitation Part 2, Boss Style Season 2)
author: MapleStory M GM
summary: Part 2 of the May 20/21 update detailed Aran and Shade growth support, Hyper Burning, M4U Boss Invitation Part 2, event shops, Boss Style Season 2, packages, and additional quality-of-life fixes.
notes: Structured summary verified against the official Nexon Forum patch note on 2026-07-27.
changes: Added Aran and Shade Hyper Burning and growth-support events.
Continued M4U Boss Invitation with its second event and shop schedule.
Opened Boss Style Season 2 and related limited packages.
Improved crystal product sorting, Rest Points, consecutive box use, and boss bound-icon placement.
